name: Hurricane Tracker
author: Olivier Melcher
description: A calm, native Omarchy hurricane tracker for NHC cyclones, regional outlooks, forecast tracks, and discussions.

barWidget.description: Active NHC storms and forecast tracks

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often Hurricane Tracker checks the National Hurricane Center for updates.

schema.label: Basin alerts
schema.description: Notify when an NHC outlook reaches your threshold anywhere in this source basin. Add location-specific proximity alerts from the app's Alerts view. Existing systems form a quiet baseline.

schema.label: Formation threshold
schema.description: Minimum seven-day tropical cyclone formation chance for basin and nearby-place notifications.

schema.label: Named storm alerts
schema.description: Also notify when NHC begins advisories for a new tropical cyclone in the selected region.
